descricao: Connection state of this line with the Official WhatsApp.
descricaoConectado: This line is connected to the Official WhatsApp.
descricaoDesconectado: Connect this line's number to your Meta account.
instrucao: When you connect, Meta opens the sign-in for your WhatsApp Business account. At the end, the number is tied to this line and templates start working.
erroEstado: Could not read the connection state.
conectadoSemWaba: The number connected, but the account (WABA) was not recorded on this line. Templates only work after that — try connecting again or contact support.
semConfiguracao: The Official WhatsApp connection is not configured on this installation. Contact support.
origemNaoAutorizada: This address ({{origem}}) is not allowed on the channel. Contact support with this address.
retornoIncompleto: The sign-in did not return the required data. Try connecting again.
conectadoHint: To change this line's number, contact support.

bloqueada.trialDescricao: This line no longer connects: the trial is over. Connecting a number requires an active subscription.
bloqueada.inativaDescricao: This line does not connect while there is no active subscription.
